steps.step: day start: clip 1.2 L shoulder-strap quiver, glider inside (power-on by removal)
push off; at >=7 m/s draw glider from quiver and release overhead (wings spring out, apparent wind = launch speed)
ride: autonomous follow 6-10 m behind/above via UWB tag + vision; regen on steep pitches
mid-run stop: glider orbits r~10 m at 2.4 W (orbit shot), rejoins on restart; no user input
end of run: glider belly-lands 3-5 m to the downhill side; skier slides to it and picks it up
insert tail-first in quiver (wings fold on the tube mouth), board lift
end of day: USB-C charge quiver+glider

S2-01.note: 3 ops/run by the strict definition (launch, pick-up, insert); 2 if pick-and-insert counts as one recovery. S2-03 is the fix (1-2 ops, 0 s standstill).

steps.step: stopped at top: press shoulder-cradle button; glider climbs vertically to 4 m, transitions to wing-borne
ride: wing-borne follow; hover only for transitions
end of run: stop; glider transitions to hover and lands in the shoulder cradle funnel (auto on standstill >3 s)
push off; release glider overhead at >=7 m/s
last 100 m: tap strap button (or automatic on lift-approach geofence); 1.5 m tag line streams from a 1.2 m pack whip
glider hooks the line at 1-2 m/s closing speed; reel draws it into the dorsal quiver in ~3 s
stop at lift: nothing to do
push off; pack boom releases kite above ~3 m/s skier speed
ride: parked at 35-50 deg elevation when fast; flies figure-8s when slow (down to ~2.2 m/s)
stop: kite glides down behind; reel retrieves into boom cradle
